scope.title: Reliability aggregation and positive/negative eval gate

decision.reason: Aggregation + runner wiring verified on a clean candidate: focused unit 6/6, typecheck:test exit 0, scoped eslint exit 0, harness validate valid + dry-run pass, runner executes and emits the reliability block. Deterministic oracle; explicitly insufficient-sample; no product-lock or default change.

lintTouched.note: warning is eslint 'file ignored' for the .d.mts (no matching config), not a code warning

independentVerification.detail: The unit test independently asserts pass^k vs pass@k divergence, incomplete preservation, flake semantics, safety and anchor gating. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Reuses the existing agent-dev benefit report and scenario registry; no new metrics platform or store; thresholds pre-registered in the fixture.
pass^k and pass@k reported separately (fixture: 0.25 vs 0.75); never mixed.
missing/timeout/crash/skip cases are incomplete, excluded from denominators, and preserved in the incomplete list.
flake = first trial failed and a later fixed re-run passed; first failure preserved; safety-required cases must be 0 skip / 0 flake.
positive must all-pass, negative must all-reject; violating either sets gate=fail.
Complete cases < minCases (20) yields gate=insufficient-sample, not PASS.
Report carries raw denominator, pass^k, pass@k, flake, missing, gate and reasons; fixture labelled deterministic.
Focused tests + typecheck:test + scoped lint + harness validate/dry-run passed; credential scan 0 hits; SHA256SUMS verifiable.
No product default/lock/approval change; no scheduled automation; no live-provider or human claim.

notMeasured: A separate second-agent independent verifier role.
Comms gates (this packet does not touch comms paths).

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
